calls.title: GrowthBook Kickoff for Capture Higher Ed
calls.summary: The meeting centered on establishing a structured approach for onboarding and experimentation focusing on dynamic landing pages with GrowthBook. Chris Sanders was confirmed as the technical lead, while Scott Keller will oversee strategic milestones. Phased experimentation was outlined, starting with SDK integration and a follow-up training to cover advanced testing methods. The team is prioritizing data pipeline readiness, with Ying Lin and Ruben Lopez tasked with ensuring the ETL process into Snowflake is reliable. Immediate use of LaunchDarkly for feature flags was agreed upon, while future consolidation with GrowthBook is planned. Open communication channels were established for rapid issue resolution, emphasizing a phased rollout to mitigate risks and ensure foundational readiness for scaling experiments.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, dynamic landing pages, multivariate experimentation, feature flags, data pipeline, Snowflake
